knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Stop, keep the material separate and confirm identity from a reliable source before any disposal decision.
Clean tools and boots before leaving an infested area, using the approved method.
Move only a covered load to a destination that has confirmed it accepts that material.

practicalCriteria: Given three plant samples with one unidentified, the learner separates and marks the unidentified sample and names the identification source they would use, within the assessor's set time.
The learner completes a simulated tool and boot cleaning sequence at the boundary of an infested zone using the approved method.
The learner completes a disposal decision sheet for a supplied load, recording whether the destination and rule are confirmed.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Signed plant identification record for the samples.
Assessor observation record of the cleaning sequence.
Completed disposal decision sheet signed by the assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Cutting, composting or moving an unidentified plant during the assessment.
Moving a load without a confirmed destination.
Handling plant sap or fruit with bare hands.
